[P2] Traverse successful batch containers to failed descendants

When a child context awaits a map or parallel operation and calls `result.throwIfError()`, its direct child is the batch container. That container checkpoints successfully with a `BatchResult`, even when an item failed, so it has no error and this filter stops the search. The enclosing context and execution report `ChildContextError` instead of the user's type, even live with the complete tree. Traverse through batch containers to failed descendants, retaining depth/cycle safeguards, and add coverage for this nesting.
